root_cause: TLS certificate on api-gateway has expired
impact: All affected hosts (batch-01, web-01, web-04) experience SSL handshake failures, leading to service unavailability for users.
severity_comment: The score and band (high) seem appropriate given the high number of affected hosts and the severity of the issue.
fix_steps: Check the TLS certificate on api-gateway and renew it.
Restart the api-gateway service to apply the new certificate.
Verify the certificate is correctly installed and accessible.
Monitor the api-gateway service for any further issues.
Notify the relevant teams about the certificate renewal and the affected hosts.
Schedule a maintenance window to perform the certificate renewal if needed.
prevention: Implement certificate rotation and auto-renewal policies to avoid such issues in the future.
